title: Customer signal catalog and launch conductor
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a lightweight, repeatable playbook that bundles the launch 'signals' (qualitative feedback, activation metrics, support burden, performance telemetry) into a single Customer Signal Catalog and a lightweight Launch Conductor role for cross-functional orchestration. This ticket produces: 1) a canonical signal catalog (what we track and why), 2) a release-notes delta table mapped to customer-visible changes, 3) a Launch Conductor checklist (who owns each coordination task during beta > lighthouse > scale), and 4) a feedback routing map that ties in Support, Success, Eng triage, and PM prioritization.

Scope: Beta programs + first 20 lighthouse accounts. Excludes full GA runbook (tracked in sibling ticket). Timebox: 3 sprints to iterate on playbook then hand off to GTM operations.

Key deliverables: 
- Signal catalog (engagement metrics, latency/cost regressions, prompt regressions, error rates, NPS/CSAT signals, customer qualitative flags) with definitions, owners, and threshold severity.
- Release-notes delta table linking code/infra changes to suggested customer-facing language and rollback triggers.
- Launch Conductor checklist with day -14 to +30 activities, communication templates, and weekly cadence.
- Feedback routing map (Slack channels, ticket labels, email aliases, and Confluence intake form) and an initial triage SLA.

Success criteria: 
- Playbook validated with 3 pilot lighthouse accounts and at least one beta cohort. 
- All launch notes drafted and reviewed by PM + Legal + Support before customer send. 
- Dashboards created for top 6 signals and alerts wired to on-call. 

Risks & trade-offs: 
- Adding more signals increases noise and slows triage; decision: prioritize 6 signals for first pass. 
- Tight timeline vs engineering bandwidth; mitigation: use lightweight instrumentation + manual checks for qualitative signals.

Next steps (owner): 
- Mateo: Draft signal catalog and publish Confluence stub (Due 2025-02-22).
- Eng leads (ENG-1842 owner): Confirm telemetry availability and add two alert endpoints (Due 2025-02-26).
- Legal: Review release notes templates (Due 2025-02-24).

Notes: This artifact will be used by CSMs during onboarding calls and by the Support rotation during beta. We'll iterate the catalog after first 10 days of pilot data.
